**A.** During repeated sprints, AMP from ADP breakdown (adenylate kinase) is deaminated to IMP, which releases ammonia. IMP is then degraded to hypoxanthine and uric acid, and all three rise in blood. Urea, creatinine and creatine aren't products of this pathway that accumulate in this way, so I'm not changing my answer in light of the team note.

CONFIDENCE: 85
